facts.fact: The World Bank ICR states that STP joined the ACE consortium in 2010 by a Construction and Maintenance Agreement signed by CST, with negotiations with Portugal Telecom concluding in successful participation; ACE links Europe with the West and Southern African coast, including Côte d'Ivoire, Gabon and Equatorial Guinea.
facts.system: ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) submarine cable

facts.fact: The World Bank ICR states that the ACE cable arrived in STP in November 2011, with the grant effective on 2011-07-06 and the cable built by the consortium; the Côte d'Ivoire to STP segment was part of ACE phase 1.
facts.system: ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) submarine cable

facts.fact: The World Bank ICR states that the ACE cable was commercially launched in February 2013 after tests across the 16 countries it connects, phase 1 segments in service including Côte d'Ivoire to STP, and the STP landing station was inaugurated in October 2012.
facts.system: ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) submarine cable
